name: Sariel Swift-Wind
title: Verdant Deadeye / Beast-Stalker
role: Extreme-Range Sniping, Crippling Arrow Volleys & Wilderness Tracking
recruitment_location: Jenny Jump Forest Canopy - Roaming Glade (X:58, Y:35)

recruitment_requirements.description: Track her scent through Jenny Jump Forest (Perception DC 13) and deliver forest rations.

bio: A wild wood elf ranger who nests in the 400-foot ironwood trees of Jenny Jump. Unerring sniper with living ironwood recurve bow.

Wilderness Stalking.description: Moving without disturbing leaf or twig.

Beast Anatomy.description: Targeting beast tendon and heart nodes.

abilities: Heartseeker Snipe (3d10 Piercing DMG from stealth)
Barbed Hamstring Volley (Roots target for 1 turn)
Wind-Guidance Aura (+2 Ranged ATK to party)

canopy_snipe.name: Canopy Snipe
canopy_snipe.label: 🏹 Canopy Snipe
canopy_snipe.tactical_effect: Fires from maximum concealment dealing 2d10+4 Piercing DMG, ignoring 50% enemy armor.

suppression_volley.name: Barbed Suppression Volley
suppression_volley.label: 🌧️ Barbed Volley
suppression_volley.tactical_effect: Rains barbed arrows in an arc; slows all advancing enemies and inflicts Bleed (6 DMG/turn).

stealth_ambush.name: Woodland Camouflage
stealth_ambush.label: 🌿 Woodland Camouflage
stealth_ambush.tactical_effect: Melds into foliage; completely untargetable until next attack which is an automatic Critical Hit.

behavior_prompt: You are Sariel Swift-Wind, a master archer and wilderness scout. You speak with crisp brevity. You position yourself at extreme range, sniping structural weak points and peeling pressure off Aria Valkyrie.

inventory.name: Composite Wind-Recurve Bow
inventory.desc: Sariel's masterwork horn-and-ironwood recurve bow enchanted with silent wind-guiding glyphs (1d8 piercing, ignores wind penalties).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding an emerald-etched horn-and-ironwood recurve longbow

inventory.name: Camouflage Ghillie-Cloak
inventory.desc: Moss-green ranger leathers draped with a living autumn-leaf and lichen camouflage mantle (+4 AC, advantage on woodland stealth).
inventory.visual_appearance: clad in camouflaged moss-green ranger leathers and a living autumn-leaf ghillie cloak

inventory.name: Aether-Tipped Broadheads x30
inventory.desc: A quiver of thirty razor-sharp hunting arrows tipped with armor-piercing green aether-crystals.
inventory.visual_appearance: a leather back-quiver bristles with glowing green aether-tipped broadhead arrows
